title: Month 1, Week 4 (Nov 29 – Dec 5, 2026): Quality & Safety I (12%), Genetics/Special Stains & Month 1 Checkpoint

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Spaced recall of CNS Embryonal & Sellar tumors.
Reading — Quality & Safety I (75m): CAP Quality Manual & Curriculum Lab Operations — Pre-analytical, Analytical, and Post-analytical errors; Specimen rejection criteria; Fixation mechanics (10% NBF penetration 1 mm/hr, 10:1–20:1 volume; Breast ER/PR/HER2 cold ischemia ≤1 hr & fixation 6–72 hrs); Decalcification (EDTA vs. strong hydrochloric/nitric acid).
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 slides @ 3m/case (Histology processing/fixation artifacts, tissue floaters, + 3 CNS review slides).
QBank (30m): 20 Lab Management & Fixation/Processing MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Study One-Pager 4 (CAP Quality Assurance, Fixatives & Decalcification Standards).

days.b1:
Retrieval (15m): Recall fixatives for EM (2.5% glutaraldehyde), IF (Michel's/Zeus medium), urate crystals (absolute ethanol), and CAP breast fixation windows.
Reading — Quality & Safety II (75m): Curriculum R4/R5 Milestones — IHC Validation & Daily Run Controls (internal vs. external controls), Turnaround Time (TAT) benchmarks (frozen section ≤20 min for 90% of cases, routine biopsy ≤2 business days), Amended vs. Addendum reports, & Critical Values.
days.b2:
Spot Slides (15m): 5 Frozen Section Pitfall Slides @ 3m/case (fat necrosis vs. carcinoma, cautery/crush artifact, ice-crystal artifact).
QBank (20m): 20 CAP Quality Assurance & IHC Troubleshooting MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Master the 4-Domain SOE Script in One-Pager 4 for Resolving a Suspected Floater Contaminant & Frozen-to-Permanent Discrepancy.

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Recite the step-by-step root-cause analysis and STR identity protocol for a suspected malignant floater on a benign biopsy slide.
days.b2:
Slide Sprint (60m): 12 Timed Slides: 6 Mixed CNS/Artifact slides (3m/case) + 6 Thyroid & Parathyroid FNA slides (Bethesda Cat I–VI full review @ 6m/case).
QBank (45m): 25 Timed Quality/Safety & Cytopathology MCQs.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Finalize your Bethesda Thyroid Cytopathology ROM, Molecular Triage, & Clinical Management entry in the SOE Log.

days.b1: Secondary System — Mendelian/Non-Mendelian Genetics & Infectious Special Stains (90m): Robbins Trinucleotide repeat expansions, Genomic imprinting (Prader-Willi pat 15q11-13 del/mat UPD vs. Angelman mat UBE3A/pat UPD), Hereditary Cancer Syndromes (Li-Fraumeni, VHL, NF1/2, MEN1/2A/2B, Cowden, Lynch, FAP), & Infectious Special Stains.
days.b2: QBank & Slides (30m): 20 Genetics & Special Stain MCQs + 5 Infectious Histopathology Spot Slides (Aspergillus 45° septate vs. Mucor 90° ribbon-like pauci-septate, Histoplasma, Cryptococcus, Actinomyces).
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log Fungal & Bacterial Morphology + Special Stains (GMS, PAS, Mucicarmine, Fontana-Masson, Ziehl-Neelsen, Fite, Warthin-Starry, Gram).

days.b1: Retrieval (15m): Blank-sheet recall of Hereditary Cancer Syndromes (genes, chromosomes, and sentinel tumors) & Fungal Special Stains.
days.b2:
QBank Sprint (60m): 30 Timed MCQs (15 Quality/Safety + 15 2015–2023 Trainee Recalls on Lab Management, QC, & Special Stains).
Deep Review (45m): Dissect every recall item.
days.b3: SOE Deliverable: Log all CAP Quality and Special Stain recall traps into the SOE Log.

days.b2: (Optional) 30m review of Month 1 SOE Log before Saturday's Checkpoint.

days.b1: Launch Month 2 Preview — Soft Tissue & Bone [Conf: 1/5] (2.0h): WHO Soft Tissue & Bone 5th Ed. — Pattern-Based Approach to Soft Tissue Tumors + Adipocytic Tumors (Lipoma variants, Spindle cell/Pleomorphic lipoma RB1 loss/CD34+, ALT/WDLPS & DDLPS MDM2/CDK4 amplification, Myxoid Liposarcoma FUS/EWSR1::DDIT3, Pleomorphic Liposarcoma).
days.b2:
Month 1 Checkpoint Assessment (2.0h):
• 50 Timed MCQs (60m): CNS (50%), General Path (15%), Molecular/EM (15%), Quality/Safety (15%), Thyroid Cyto (5%).
• 15 Timed Spot Slides (45m @ 3m/case): 10 CNS + 3 Adipocytic Soft Tissue + 2 Infectious/General Path.
days.b3: Month 1 Audit (30m): Score Checkpoint 1, update Confidence Sliders, click Push, and switch Month dropdown to 2 - Dec 2026.
